decisions.target: All Kestrel Air passengers and followers

actions.action: Lease an aircraft with crew for 2 weeks

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: you may have seen a video of mechanics working on one of our engines. The FAA and the engine maker asked airlines to inspect a part on one engine type, as a precaution. No Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. We are inspecting the aircraft that use it now, and a few flights may be delayed while we do. Safety comes first. We have leased an extra aircraft with crew to keep your flights running during the checks.
decisions.why:
If checks take aircraft out of service, a spare plane keeps the schedule whole over Thanksgiving week.
It protects goal 1 and revenue if the inspections run long.
It costs $0.7M.
